circular_shift_null.shift_semantics: circularly rotate complete gate, score, gap, and evaluability sequences; DSCOVR anchors remain fixed
circular_shift_null.pairwise_constraint: DSCOVR-to-ACE, DSCOVR-to-Wind, and ACE-to-Wind circular separations all at least 16 minutes

mismatched_day_null.selection_rule: fixed nonzero prime-number day offsets declared before telemetry retrieval
mismatched_day_null.alignment: minute-of-UTC-day only; dates remain recorded and are not treated as simultaneous

interpretation_limits: hard-null controls preserve the frozen 45-degree/25-percent gate and timing radii
circular shifts preserve each series' autocorrelation and gate clustering but impose a periodic day boundary
mismatched-day controls break simultaneity but may differ in activity level
empirical tail fractions are conditional on these control constructions and are not independent-minute probabilities
quiet, moderate, and isolated-structure event-class controls remain required
a low empirical tail fraction does not prove one common discontinuity
spacecraft geometry, discontinuity normals, and propagation are not evaluated
GSE vector rotation is not a GSM clock-angle or geoeffectiveness claim
no interpolation or forward fill is permitted
negative and mixed results are first-class outputs
